question: Which restaurant is closest when progressing from North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH toward African American Cultural Garden, Cleveland, OH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.629472 41.530044)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.910184 41.423463)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: North Olmsted Recreation Center, North Olmsted, OH

[3].display_name: African American Cultural Garden, Cleveland, OH
